projects.name: Computer Lab - Rural School
projects.description: Pushpa Foundation established fully equipped computer labs in two rural schools located in Anjangao Kh. and Bembale, Maharashtra, helping students gain essential digital skills.

projects.name: Girls’ Restroom Construction – Upalai Village School
projects.description: Dedicated rest rooms were built for girls in the rural school at Upalai village, Maharashtra, creating a safer and more inclusive learning environment.

projects.name: Community Care Initiative
projects.description: Sweaters were provided to orphanage children in Maharashtra, and over 200 sarees were donated to women in rural communities.

projects.name: Tree Plantation in Rural Area
projects.description: Pushpa Foundation has planted 100+ trees across rural regions of Maharashtra, supporting cleaner air, healthier soil, and long-term ecological balance.
